item.description: South Kesteven District Council’s popular SK Community Awards are back. The awards turn the spotlight on some very special people to recognise and reward their work. item.title: Wildlife Trust appeal to save important habitat near Grantham
item.description: The Lincolnshire Wildlife Trust have an appeal to raise money to purchase and save 87 hectares of important meadow habitat, near Grantham. It is at Hawthorpe between Irnham and Rippingale. If anyone would like more information or make a donation click on https://www.lincstrust.org.uk/hawthorpe-appeal The post Wildlife Trust appeal to save important habitat near Grantham appeared first on Grantham Matters.

item.title: Beneath Big Skies’: Paintings celebrating Lincolnshire’s rural heritage go on display
item.description: Don’t miss your chance to see Lincolnshire artist Robin Wheeldon’s beautiful oil paintings as one of the largest exhibitions of his work goes on display at the Museum of Lincolnshire Life. For the past 40 years, Robin has captured the heart and soul of the county’s rural life and proud engineering heritage. item.title: £150,000 funding to support older people facing poverty
